calls.title: Review Pricing Changes Project & Timeline
calls.summary: The team convened to prepare for the launch of the new pricing strategy, emphasizing clear ownership and technical requirements. Key discussions included the low-effort integration between Orb and Stripe, where enterprise usage plans will transition to Orb with minimal engineering changes. A feature-specific grandfathering strategy was established to manage legacy users effectively. The managed warehouse auto-provisioning is nearing completion, highlighting compliance with EU data residency laws. Plans for limiting projects and environments according to service tiers were debated, ensuring that free users face specific restrictions while retaining some functionality in Pro and Enterprise plans. The phased rollout approach was favored, with a target date set for early July, particularly mindful of EU compliance challenges.
calls.keywords: pricing launch, grandfathering, managed warehouse, event forwarder, EU data compliance, feature flagging
